title: Multi-scale constraint-based modeling of hepatic metabolic adaptation to diet: code and frozen results (v1.0.0)
description: Code, inputs and frozen results for Madadjim, Vechetti & Cui, 'Multi-scale constraint-based modeling reveals conserved and context-dependent hepatic metabolic adaptation to diet' (Briefings in Bioinformatics, BIB-26-1735). A three-layer E-Flux architecture (diet exchange bounds, transporter capacities, intracellular capacities) on the iMM1415 mouse model is applied to six bulk liver cohorts, nine genetically diverse strains, a single-cell liver atlas and a MICOM gut community. Includes one orchestrator, automated verification of 34 manuscript headline numbers, figure scripts, benchmarks and sensitivity analyses. Large single-cell data and full production outputs are in the companion data record.
